== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Was known in Chinese solo queue as a {{ci|Janna}} one-trick before playing competitively.
* His ID was '''Lwandy''', but he renamed to his ID '''Iwandy''' when he moved to LNG.
* Reached Rank 1 in the Korean Solo Queue with 1807 LP on March 18, 2022.
** This set the new record for the highest points in the Korean Solo Queue, which was later supassed by [[Canyon]] in June 2022 with 1809 LP.
